docsTitle: Required Documents for Engineer ・ Humanities ・ International
tips:
・Engineer・Humanities・International visa is for **professional and technical work** requiring university-level education or expertise

・Covers **engineering, IT, finance, marketing, translation, design** and other professional fields

・Check the latest application requirements at the [Immigration Services Agency](https://www.moj.go.jp/isa/)

・Requires **bachelor's degree or equivalent experience** in the relevant field of work

・Employing company must meet specific **business scale and financial requirements** based on category classification
